description_en: Creates an anti-ransomware policy for a database
description_zh: 创建数据库勒索病毒防护策略
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-uni-backup-policy --policy-name mysql-policy --instance-id i-bp1fu4aqltf1huhc0000 --database-type MYSQL --retention 7 --speed-limiter 5242880 --uni-region-id cn-hangzhou --full-plan '{"key":"example-string"}' --inc-plan '{"key":"example-string"}' --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUniBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The name of the anti-ransomware policy
parameters.help_zh: 防勒索备份策略的名称
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

You can call the [DescribeUniBackupDatabase](~~DescribeUniBackupDatabase~~) operation to query the IDs of ECS instances
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例的ID。
调用[DescribeUniBackupDatabase](~~DescribeUniBackupDatabase~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server whose data is backed up based on the anti-ransomware policy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141932.html operation to query the UUIDs of servers
parameters.help_zh:
数据库防勒索所备份服务器的UUID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141932.html接口获取服务器的UUID
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

MYSQL
ORACLE
MSSQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，取值如下：

MYSQL
ORACLE
MSSQL
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en: The retention period of backup data
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en: The maximum network bandwidth that is allowed during data backup. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 备份网络带宽限制。单位为字节
parameters.name: speed_limiter

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the database account
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is manually added. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
parameters.help_zh:
数据库是否用户添加。取值：

true：是
false：否
parameters.name: database_add_by_user

parameters.help_en: The region in which the server resides
parameters.help_zh: 备份策略防护的服务器所在的地域
parameters.name: uni_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The policy for full data backup. The value of this parameter is a JSON string. The JSON string contains the following fields:

start: the start time of a backup task.
interval: the interval of backup tasks.
type: the unit of the interval.
days: the days of a week on which a backup task is performed
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份策略。格式为JSON格式。包含以下字段：

start：备份开始时间
interval：间隔周期
type：间隔周期单位
days：周中执行日期
parameters.name: full_plan

parameters.help_en:
The policy for incremental data backup. The value of this parameter is a JSON string. The JSON string contains the following fields:

start: the start time of a backup task.
interval: the interval of backup tasks.
type: the unit of the interval.
days: the days of a week on which a backup task is performed
parameters.help_zh:
增量备份策略。格式为JSON格式。包含以下字段：
start：备份开始时间
interval：间隔周期
type：间隔周期单位
days：周中执行日期
parameters.name: inc_plan

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
